# Mile High Smoke Shop & Convenience

> Smoke shop and convenience store in Orlando, Florida (South Orange Blossom Trail / Southland Blvd area). We sell vapes, glass, hookah and rolling supplies, with in-store pickup, same-day local delivery within about 5 miles, and nationwide shipping on eligible non-nicotine items. Adults 21 and older only. We serve customers in English and Spanish.

## Store facts

- Name: Mile High Smoke Shop & Convenience
- Address: 7400 Southland Blvd #113, Orlando, FL 32809
- Phone: +1 689-233-8293
- Hours: Open every day, 10:00 AM to 11:00 PM
- Price range: moderate ($$)
- Rating: 5.0 stars (208 reviews)
- Area served: Orlando and surrounding Central Florida; nationwide shipping on eligible items
- Languages: English and Spanish
- Age policy: 21+ only. The site is age-gated.

## What we sell

- Vapes and disposables (RAZ, Lost Mary, Geek Bar, Off-Stamp, Foger, NEXA, Crown Bar, WeFume, AirFuze and more)
- Glass and pipes (water pipes, hand pipes, bubblers, dab rigs)
- Hookah and shisha (hookahs, Adalya and Al Fakher tobacco)
- Rolling and wraps (RAW, Bambu, JOB, OCB, Elements, Zig-Zag, King Palm, Blazy Susan, Cyclones, Juicy Jay's, papers, cones, wraps, filters and tips)
- Coming soon: cigars, grinders and accessories, apparel, and adult products

## How to buy

- In-store pickup at the Orlando location
- Same-day local delivery by our own driver within roughly 5 miles
- Nationwide shipping on eligible items. By federal law (PACT Act) we do not ship vapes, e-liquids, or tobacco; those are in-store or local delivery only. Rolling papers, wraps, cones and similar non-nicotine items can ship.

## Compliance

- All sales require the customer to be 21 or older with valid ID.
- Nicotine and tobacco products are not shipped; they are available for in-store pickup or local delivery only.
